title: Scoped workplace projections require verified provenance and frozen responsibility bindings
summary: Keep owner hierarchy, viewer authorization and operation responsibility separate; never infer sensitivity or transfer old approvals when bindings change.
reusable_steps: Keep owner hierarchy, viewer authorization and operation responsibility separate; never infer sensitivity or transfer old approvals when bindings change
expected_outcome: Apply when adding a UI projection across tenant, organization, Project and Operation. Resolve real registry parents and narrow the authenticated viewer; URL selections never grant authority. A WorkItem without a sensitivity tier requires an authoritative owner or a durable admission that matches the current source responsibility binding; otherwise withhold it. Freeze operation responsibility in admission identity, approval provenance and work metadata. A changed or removed binding must preserve old parked decisions without reinterpreting them as new work. Use locked optimistic owner/status/binding checks for autonomous controls. Display unavailable counts as unknown and distinguish future wakeup suspension from cancellation. Verify with real registry and artifact storage, sibling and mixed-tier fixtures, stale decision regression tests and mounted UI recovery tests.
